items.headline: The Morning Build for November 21, 2026: Nvidia CEO Resigns, Anthropic IPO Reaffirms Pacing, Meta Rewrites Net-Zero
items.excerpt: Nvidia’s CEO resignation and congressional testifying deadline, Anthropic’s IPO and pacing pledge, and Meta’s 2030 net-zero rethink after record data center emissions.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 20, 2026: OpenSSL CVE Fix, Gemini 4 Neon, Apple and Agent Controls
items.excerpt: OpenSSL merges CVE-2026-121481 fix; Google ships Gemini 4 Neon and Tool Retrieval; Apple signals an in-house Mac agent; Hermes adds Collective Wisdom in Teams.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 19, 2026: Google rolls Gemini 4 Neon, critical NGINX RCEs, Nadella on 60k buyouts, and Nvidia delays a 10-Q
items.excerpt: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with 1M-token context; two critical NGINX HTTP/2 RCEs fixed in recent NGINX releases; Nadella defends 60k buyouts; Nvidia delays 10-Q.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 18, 2026: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Nvidia pulls H200 from China, and Copilot becomes the work OS
items.excerpt: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API pricing; Nvidia stops H200 sales to China; Microsoft embeds Office in Copilot; a travel-agent seed and a surge in AI CSAM reports.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 17, 2026: OpenAI embeds external evaluators, new CSAM tools, and Qwen4-Max price/scale moves
items.excerpt: OpenAI embeds third-party evaluators and adds CSAM image classification; GPT-6 aids a lattice proof; US export rules tighten in 90 days; Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 16, 2026: Anthropic’s Fable Paints with Code, and Nvidia Faces Leadership, Security, and Geopolitics Tests
items.excerpt: Anthropic shows brushstroke-based image synthesis in Claude Fable 5.2; CEO Amodei warns of compute risk ahead of Nov 19 IPO; Nvidia’s leadership exit raises security and geopolitical questions.

items.headline: The Morning Build for November 15, 2026: ChatGPT Wallet, LangChain's $3B Round, and Meituan's 1.6T Agent Model
items.excerpt: ChatGPT Wallet launches a limited agent checkout test; LangChain raises $300M at a $3B valuation; Meituan publishes LongCat-2.5 weights and self-hosting guide.
